methodologyNotes: Covers Pilates reformers: the spring-resisted sliding-carriage machines used for reformer Pilates, sold as a complete machine at a published US price. Includes studio-grade, home/foldable, and connected (app-guided) reformers; excludes reformer/tower combos priced only as a bundle, Cadillac/trapeze tables, wunda chairs, and accessory-only listings. Price is typical US MSRP or street price, USD, for the base machine. frameMaterial is the primary frame material (e.g. 'maple', 'aluminum', 'steel'). reformerLengthIn is the overall machine length in inches. reformerWidthIn is the overall width in inches. carriageTravelIn is the usable carriage travel/stroke in inches. springCount is the number of resistance springs included. maxUserWeightLbs is the manufacturer's rated maximum user weight in pounds. machineWeightLbs is the assembled machine weight in pounds. footbarPositions is the number of adjustable footbar positions. deckHeightIn is the carriage/deck height off the floor in inches. foldable is a boolean for a folding/storable frame. connectedApp is a boolean for an official guided-workout app or screen integration. Any spec not stated verbatim on a fetched manufacturer or retailer/review page is left null.
